name: Ifaikah Kalidin
review_text:
Salah satu destinasi wisata di pesisir selatan pulau Madura. Akses menuju lokasi mudah banget karena berada tepat di pinggir jalan raya, berseberangan dengan kantor kecamatan. Lokasinya cukup dekat dengan Jembatan Suramadu. Dikelola secara swadaya oleh masyarakat. Tiket masuk murah banget, hanya bayar 5k/motor, 10k/mobil.
Area pantai sangat bersih, berpasir putih, bebatuan koral, dan tanaman khas pantai. Di waktu tertentu, air laut jernih dan berwarna agak kebiruan. Saat air laut surut, ada batu karang yang bisa dijadikan area mencari keong laut.
Ada area bermain buat anak-anak. Meski tidak cukup banyak. Saranku yang mau main ke sini, bawa mainan pantai dan baju ganti buat anak main air. Toilet umum yang tersedia hanya satu.
Area pantai tidak terlalu luas. Tetapi cukuplah untuk mantai dengan latar pemandangan Jembatan Suramadu. Oya, Kalau bawa anak-anak, jangan sampai lepas pengawasan ya agar tetap aman.
review_translated_text:
One of the tourist destinations on the south coast of Madura Island. Access to the location is very easy because it is right on the side of the main road, opposite the sub-district office. The location is quite close to the Suramadu Bridge. Managed independently by the community. Entrance tickets are really cheap, only pay 5k/motorbike, 10k/car.
The beach area is very clean, white sand, coral rocks and typical beach plants. At certain times, the sea water is clear and slightly bluish in color. When the sea water recedes, there are rocks that can be used as an area to look for sea snails.
There is a play area for children. Although not enough. My advice to those who want to play here, bring beach toys and a change of clothes for children to play in the water. There is only one public toilet available.
The beach area is not very wide. But it's enough to relax with a view of the Suramadu Bridge in the background. Oh yes, if you bring children, don't leave them unsupervised to keep them safe.

review_translated_text:
Goa Petapa Beach
Entrance fee for two people + motorcycle parking: 5,000 rupiah (July 2023)
Spacious motorcycle parking, with room for several cars.
The view is beautiful, the beach is clean, and you can clearly see Surabaya and the Suramadu Bridge from here.
There are food stalls here. Food and drink prices are affordable.
Young coconut ice with shell costs 13,000 rupiah. The coconut ice stall is very aesthetic and cute.
Lots of coral along the shore, and jellyfish abound in the coral.
For those in Surabaya who want to see a beach, this beach might be a worthwhile destination. It's close to Surabaya. From Suramadu, look for the road to the right and then continue east.

Akses jalan dari arah SBY bisa dikatakan jelek ya ges makadam gitu(ini yang dari suramadu setelah jalan raya utama dan sebaliknya). Disarankan juga pakai motor saja karna jalannya juga kecil dan sempit. Pantai berada di sisi tebing, jadi pas masuk jalannya agak curam ke bawah gitu.

Untuk kekurangannya, masih banyak terdapat sampah di area pinggir-pinggir tapi kalau liat-liat air lautnya bersih warna hijau ga kotor-kotor banget. Selebihnya oke.
review_translated_text:
Wow, honestly this exceeded my expectations lol. I thought the northern beaches were identical with black and muddy sand, and it turns out this one is nice. The sand is clean white and there are some corals. 

Although the beach is small, the facilities here are quite adequate, there are several stalls, seesaw games, a boat photo area, and toilets. The ticket price is only IDR 5,000 per motorbike + person, if the car is IDR 10,000, it's affordable, right? 

The road access from the direction of SBY can be said to be bad, right? It's like macadam (this is from Suramadu after the main highway and vice versa). It is also recommended to use a motorbike because the road is also small and narrow. The beach is on the side of a cliff, so when you enter the road is a bit steep down. 

For the drawbacks, there is still a lot of garbage on the edges, but if you look closely, the sea water is clean green, not too dirty. The rest is okay.

Visit on weekdays and national holidays.
Entrance fee per person IDR 5,000
The parking fee for cars is IDR 10,000 and motorbikes IDR 5,000

There is a local shop next to the entrance which sells very well, there are toilets and showers for rinsing.

The beach atmosphere is quiet, comfortable, there is quite a bit of visitor rubbish strewn about even though notices have been given in every corner to maintain cleanliness and throw away the rubbish they carry in the rubbish bins that have been provided.

Soft white sand beach with calm waves typical of the north coast, there are no life guards/lifeguards so if you swim you have to be careful, especially those with children who need extra attention.

review_text:
Ke sini saat moment yang tepat di sunset sore hari. Tempatnya bersih tidak bau amis laut. Dengan konsep marketing yang bagus , seluruh pengunjung melewati open gate yang secara tidak langsung membuat pengynjung harus memesan makanan dulu meski tidak ada tiket masuk.
Spot foto yang indah untuk melihat jembatan suramadu dengan kelap kelipnya serta Surabaya city view.
Terdapat area duduk duduk yang nyaman dengan kursi maupun lesehan. Dan area spit foto dibagi menjadi dua, berbayar atau tidak . Untuk area berbayar dikenakan 25rb rupiah per orang,tapi menurut saya worth it banget karena memang bisa dapat foto foto yang indah.
Kami pesan minuman degan yang sangat enak, bener bener kelapa muda yang fresh tidak keras serta snack platter yang enak. Jamur krispinya bener bener renyah dan tidak pelit bumbu.
Saya mengajak teman bule saya dan dia sangat suka.
review_translated_text:
Come here at the right moment at sunset in the afternoon. The place is clean and does not smell fishy from the sea. With a good marketing concept, all visitors pass through an open gate which indirectly means visitors have to order food first even though there is no entrance ticket.
A beautiful photo spot to see the Surabaya bridge with its twinkling lights and the Surabaya city view.
There is a comfortable sitting area with chairs and a sofa. And the photo spit area is divided into two, paid or not. For the paid area it costs 25 thousand rupiah per person, but in my opinion it is really worth it because you can really get beautiful photos.
We ordered really delicious drinks, really fresh young coconut that wasn't hard and a delicious snack platter. The crispy mushrooms are really crunchy and not stingy on seasoning.
I invited my Caucasian friend and he really liked it.

name: Budianto Tejo
review_text:
Biaya masuk 4 orang dan parkir 1 mobil hanya 15rb. Mungkin karena datang di hari biasa. Jadi lebih murah. Pantainya cukup luas bisa untuk datang 2 bis lah. Sayang masih banyak yang buang sampah di sembarang tempat. Ada 3 stan yang berjualan rojek(rujak), popmie, snack, makanan ringan dan minuman. Serta toserba yang cukup lengkap, di sertai kamar mandi yang bersih, biaya 2rb sekali pakai.
Menurut saya untuk low budget trip recommended nih. Dan sekedar mengingatkan, pantai ini milik bersama akan lebih baik jika kita menjaganya dengan tidak buang sampah sembarangan. Terima kasih.
review_translated_text:
The entrance fee for four people and parking for one car is only 15,000 Rupiah. Perhaps because we came on a weekday, it's cheaper. The beach is wide enough to accommodate two buses. Unfortunately, many people still litter. There are three stalls selling rojek (rujak), instant noodles, snacks, light meals, and drinks. There's also a fairly well-stocked convenience store with clean bathrooms, which cost 2,000 Rupiah per use.
I think this is recommended for a low-budget trip. And just a reminder, this beach is shared property, and it would be better if we all take care of it by not littering. Thank you.

review_text: Pantai Rongkang yang sesuai dengan namanya yang artinya adalah pantai karang. Berlokasi di daerah Kwanyar, pantai ini ramai pada saat Hari Raya Idul Fitri yang mana puncak keramaian adalah 7 hari dari Hari Raya Idul Fitri yang disebut Hari Raya Ketupat. Banyak keluarga yang bertamasya kesini untuk menaiki perahu sampai tengah lalu kembali lagi (ya kalau gak balik entar pada heboh, hehe). Ditambah hiburan orkes dan Pasar Malam membuat Pantai Rongkang sangat hidup. Di jalan menuju Pantai ini banyak pohon yang membentuk lorong yang bagus untuk dijadikan foto prewed.
review_translated_text: Rongkang Beach, as the name suggests, means a coral beach. Located in the Kwanyar area, this beach is crowded during Eid al-Fitr, where the peak of the crowd is 7 days from Eid al-Fitr which is called Ketupat Day. Many families come here to ride a boat to the middle and then return (yes, if they don't return, it will be a commotion, hehe). Plus, the orchestra entertainment and the Night Market make Rongkang Beach very lively. On the road to this beach, there are many trees that form a good alley for pre-wedding photos.

Pantai Tengket: Permata Tersembunyi di Madura
Pantai Tengket, yang terletak di Kecamatan Sepulu, Kabupaten Bangkalan, Madura, adalah salah satu destinasi wisata yang semakin populer. Dengan pesona alam yang masih asri dan suasana yang tenang, pantai ini menawarkan pengalaman liburan yang berbeda.
Apa yang Membuat Pantai Tengket Menarik?
* Keindahan Alam: Pantai Tengket menyuguhkan pemandangan yang memukau dengan pasir putih yang lembut, air laut yang jernih, dan deburan ombak yang menenangkan.
* Suasana Tenang: Jauh dari hiruk pikuk kota, pantai ini menawarkan suasana yang tenang dan cocok untuk bersantai.
* Spot Foto Menarik: Banyak spot foto menarik di sekitar pantai, seperti gazebo, ayunan, dan pohon cemara yang rindang.
* Akses Mudah: Lokasi pantai ini cukup mudah dijangkau dan terdapat banyak penanda jalan menuju lokasi.
* Harga Terjangkau: Biaya masuk ke pantai ini sangat terjangkau, sehingga cocok untuk semua kalangan.
Aktivitas yang Bisa Dilakukan:
* Bersantai di Pantai: Nikmati suasana pantai sambil membaca buku, mendengarkan musik, atau hanya sekadar menikmati pemandangan.
* Bermain Air: Berenang, bermain pasir, atau membangun istana pasir bersama keluarga.
* Menikmati Sunset: Saksikan keindahan matahari terbenam yang memukau dari bibir pantai.
* Berkeliling Pantai: Jelajahi setiap sudut pantai untuk menemukan spot-spot menarik.
Tips Berkunjung ke Pantai Tengket:
* Waktu Terbaik: Kunjungi pantai pada pagi atau sore hari untuk menghindari terik matahari.
* Bawa Perlengkapan: Jangan lupa membawa sunscreen, topi, kacamata hitam, dan perlengkapan mandi.
* Jaga Kebersihan: Buang sampah pada tempatnya dan jangan merusak lingkungan sekitar.
Kesimpulan
Pantai Tengket adalah pilihan yang tepat bagi Anda yang ingin menikmati keindahan alam sambil melepas penat. Dengan segala keindahan dan fasilitas yang ditawarkan, pantai ini layak untuk dikunjungi.

name: The Mift
review_text:
2 jam dr Sby via Suramadu. Pantai pasir putih terdekat dr Sby, tp bny karang dan batu yg bikin tdk leluasa berlarian.. 
Sampah sll ada, tp msh mending drpd pantai2 di Sby. Lumayan bagus dan jernih kehijauan airnya. Free HTM, hny parkir 5rb (motor) dan 20rb (mobil). Paling enak kesini waktu pagi dibawah jam 10, ato sore diatas jam 3. Klo dtg siang, duduk2 cozy di bungalow sambil menikmati semilir angin pantai jg oke sih, harga mamin di warung jg normal
review_translated_text:
2 hours from Surabaya via Suramadu. The closest white sand beach from Surabaya, but there are lots of coral and rocks that make it difficult to run around freely. 
There's always trash, but it's still better than the beaches in Surabaya. It's quite nice and the water is clear and greenish. Free admission, but parking is only 5,000 Rupiah (motorcycle) and 20,000 Rupiah (car). The best time to come here is in the morning before 10 AM, or in the afternoon after 3 PM. If you come in the afternoon, sitting comfortably in the bungalow while enjoying the sea breeze is also okay, and food prices at the food stalls are also normal.

I visited here on 19-8-2023. . .
.
.
.
In my opinion, the place is quite nice and comfortable because it is clean from rubbish, the HTM is only 5 thousand up front for parking fees. . . .
.
.
.
If the day is relatively hot, it is more suitable to come here in the afternoon because it is cooler to enjoy the gentle breeze from the sea. . . .
.
.
.
The price of pop noodles here is affordable because it's only 8 thousand, in other tourist spots it would have been up to 10 thousand hahaha. . . . .
.
.
.
For the price of drinks, I only bought pop ice, a regular plastic cup at a price of 5 thousand, which is standard. . . . .
.
.
.
There is a toilet, it's free, but the door can't be locked hehe. . . . . .
.
.
.

.

.
.

name: Junea Fellayati Puttu Sabila
review_text:
Perjalanan dari Surabaya, jalan menyenangkan dan mulus.
Hanya akses masuknya memang sempit, tapu masih sangat bisa dilalui.
Uang parkir mobil IDR 20,000.
Uang masuk gratis.
Sayang sekali banyak sampah.
Padahal pasir dan pemandangannya betul-betul indah. Pasirnya sangat amat halus, seperti di ayak. Bukan berupa butiran seperti pantai yang biasa saya datangi di Bali.

Warung makan ada banyak. Jual pop mie, rujak, bakso dan berbagai macam minuman dingin dan biasa. Kopi sachet pun ada.

Mohon pengelola lebih perhatian lagi terhadap sampah yang ada disana. Lebih baik lagi diingatkan atau dibikin saja denda jika ada yang buang sampah tidak di tempatnya.
Terimakasih.
review_translated_text:
The journey from Surabaya was pleasant and smooth.
The access road is narrow, but still very passable.
Parking is IDR 20,000.
Admission is free.
It's a shame there's so much trash.
The sand and scenery are truly beautiful. The sand is incredibly fine, as if sifted. Not the granular sand I usually find on beaches in Bali.

There are plenty of food stalls selling instant noodles, rujak (fruit salad), meatball soup, and a variety of cold and regular drinks. There's also sachet coffee.

I hope the management pays more attention to the trash there. It would be better to remind people or even fine them for littering.
Thank you.

name: Hasby Asshiddiqi
review_text:
Jujur tempatnya banyak sampah, kemungkinan saat air laut pasang sampah2 tersebut terbawa ke pantai.
Tapi untuk air kelihatan jernih. Pantainya cukup dangkal, jadi cocok buat main sama anak.
Untuk akses menuju pantai, sempit hingga cukup dilalui untuk mobil dari satu arah saja. Dan area jalan pantai berpasir sehingga agak sulit bagi pesepeda motor.
Fasilitas di sini ada: toilet, warung2, gubuk2, spot foto.
Untuk mushola di sini tidak ada, kata warga sana hancur gara2 gelombang tinggi saat letusan gunung Semeru meletus tahun 2021 silam. Jadi saya waktu itu sholat ashar di warung warga, untuk wudhu langsung pake air laut.
Untuk masuk cukup bayar parkir saja, 5k untuk sepeda motor dan 20k untuk mobil.
review_translated_text:
Honestly, there is a lot of trash, probably when the sea water rises, the trash is carried to the beach. 
But the water looks clear. The beach is quite shallow, so it is suitable for playing with children. 
For access to the beach, it is narrow enough for cars from one direction only. And the sandy beach road area makes it a bit difficult for motorcyclists. 
The facilities here are: toilets, stalls, huts, photo spots. 
There is no prayer room here, according to local residents it was destroyed by high waves when Mount Semeru erupted in 2021. So at that time I prayed Asr at a local stall, for ablution I used sea water directly. 
To enter, you only have to pay for parking, 5k for motorbikes and 20k for cars.

review_translated_text: Martajasah Beach is located near the center of Bangkalan, Madura. It's on the same route as Mbah Cholil's tomb. It's about a 10-minute drive from downtown Bangkalan. This beach offers a captivating view of its white limestone terrain. Equipped with children's play areas and food stalls, the beach's management, comprised of local residents, continues to strive for development. The entrance fee is only 5,000 Rupiah. Once you enter the beach, you can also enjoy mangrove tourism. Walk along the bamboo bridge to see the mangrove forest, which is teeming with monkeys. There are also restaurants and hotels within the beach area. Just don't expect to enjoy a stretch of sandy beach, as this beach has a steep shoreline, dropping 2-3 meters into the water. There are also many mangrove forests and swamps. Next to it is a river estuary that is still used by fishing boats. #literasyikgalih #kilasdokumenter @galih.wib

name: Ovan Rangga
review_text:
Pantai ini cukup nyaman untuk dikunjungi. Ada juga beberapa fasilitas yang menunjang pantai ini, seperti warkop, parkiran, toilet, dan beberapa tempat untuk bersantai.

Untuk mengakses pantai ini cukup mudah. Jalan masuk berada di tepi jalan raya, namun jalannya menurun, karena pantai berada di bawah jalan raya. Jalan menuju pantai juga cukup bagus Dan tidak terlalu miring.

Setalah menuruni jalan, ada dua lahan parkir yang cukup luas dan teduh. Di depan bangunan ada parkir untuk motor, sedangkan untuk mobil berada di samping, di lahan yang kosong. Biaya parkir disini untuk motor hanya Rp5000 saja, dan tempat parkir selalu dijaga dengan baik (selalu ada penjaga yang standby di jalan masuk).

Di pantai ini ada warkop, tipikal warkop warkop pada umumnya. Disini juga ada tempat untuk nongkrong, baik di tepi warkop atau di tepi laut. Selain itu, ada juga warung lain yang menjual makanan dan minuman ringan.

Pemandangan pantai ini cukup indah. Dari pantai ini dapat terlihat Jembatan Suramadu dan juga gedung-gedung pencakar langit di Surabaya.

Pengunjung bisa sekedar bersantai menikmati keindahan pantai. Selain itu, pengunjung juga bisa mencari kerang, bahkan bermain air.

Toilet disini juga cukup nyaman. Namun harus lebih hemat karena keran airnya berada di luar (disalurkan melalui keran) sehingga jika habis tidak bisa dinyalakan.

Di sebelah timur dari pantai ini juga terdapat punden yang nampaknya dikeramatkan oleh warga sekitar.

Kekurangan dari tempat ini sama seperti pantai lainnya, yaitu banyak sampahnya. Alangkah baiknya jika pengelola menyediakan beberapa tempat sampah, karena saat saya ke sana, saya agak kesulitan mencari tempat sampah. Dan juga dimohon kesadaran dari para pengunjung untuk minimal tidak buang sampah sembarang. Lebih baik lagi jika membantu membersihkan beberapa sampah.
review_translated_text:
This beach is quite comfortable to visit. There are also several facilities, such as a coffee shop (warkop), parking, restrooms, and several places to relax.

Accessing this beach is quite easy. The entrance is at the edge of the main road, but the road is downhill, as the beach is located below the main road. The road to the beach is also quite good and not too steep.

After descending the road, there are two fairly spacious and shaded parking areas. In front of the building is a motorcycle parking area, while cars are located to the side, in an empty lot. Parking here for motorcycles is only IDR 5,000, and the parking area is always well-maintained (there is always a guard on duty at the entrance).

There is a coffee shop on this beach, typical of most coffee shops. There are also places to hang out, either by the coffee shop or by the sea. There are also other stalls selling food and soft drinks.

The view of this beach is quite beautiful. From here, you can see the Suramadu Bridge and the skyscrapers of Surabaya.

Visitors can simply relax and enjoy the beauty of the beach. Additionally, visitors can also look for shells and even play in the water.

The restrooms here are quite comfortable. However, they need to be more economical because the water taps are located outside (channeled through a faucet), so they can't be turned on when they run out.

To the east of this beach, there's also a sacred shrine that appears to be sacred to the locals.

The downside to this spot, like other beaches, is the abundance of trash. It would be nice if the management provided several trash bins, as I had a hard time finding one when I was there. Visitors are also asked to be mindful of littering. It would be even better if they helped clean up some of the trash.

name: Bang Tora
review_text: Sesuai namanya, Pantai Siring Kemuning, pasir pantai ini berwarna kekuningan. Pantai ini bisa dibilang adalah "Pantai Kuta" nya Madura. Menurut cerita warga sekitar, dulu sekitar tahun 1955, pantai ini sangat hits oleh wisatawan asing yang datang ke pantai ini. Kebanyakan wisatawan tersebut adalah wisman dari Australia yang ingin santai di pasir, berjemur dan keramahtamahan. Namun sekarang pantai ini sepi pengunjung karena fasilitasnya yang mulai tidak terawat, banyak sampah, serta penambangan pasir secara masif dan besar-besaran sehingga berdampak pada lingkungan pantai. Oh ya, tiket masuk pantai ini cukup murah, hanya Rp 3000/orang.
review_translated_text: As the name suggests, Siring Kemuning Beach boasts a yellowish sand. It's arguably Madura's "Kuta Beach." Locals say that around 1955, this beach was a hit with foreign tourists. Most of these visitors were Australians, seeking to relax on the sand, sunbathe, and enjoy the hospitality. However, the beach is now deserted due to neglected facilities, litter, and extensive sand mining, which has negatively impacted the beach's environment. By the way, entrance fees are quite affordable, only Rp 3,000 per person.

Lokasinya sangat dekat dengan Patung Surabaya Raksasa, bersebelahan malah.
Spot foto dan nongki yang tersusun dari bongkahan batu (atau karang) yang tergeletak di pinggir pantai.
Sebenarnya cocok ke sini jika pagi hari karena bisa melihat sunrise, tapi sore hari juga bagus koq..

review_translated_text:
One of the new tourist spots around Kenjeran, Surabaya. It used to be called Watu-Watu Kenjeran, if I'm not mistaken. For some reason, it was removed from Maps and replaced with this.
It's very close to the Giant Surabaya Statue, in fact, right next door.
This photo and hangout spot is made up of boulders (or coral) lying along the beach.
It's actually best to come here in the morning to watch the sunrise, but the afternoon is also great.
You can relax and enjoy meatballs or young coconut ice along this spot.

name: Febri Ariyanto
review_text:
Pagi itu, udara segar memenuhi jalan menuju Pantai Kenjeran. Aku melangkah pelan, merasakan embusan angin sejuk. Di sepanjang perjalanan, pepohonan hijau menyapa dengan daunnya yang berdesir lembut. Ketika sampai di tepi pantai, mataku disuguhi panorama yang memukau: langit sedikit mendung dengan matahari pagi yang mulai naik, memantulkan cahaya ke permukaan laut yang tenang. Aku duduk di bebatuan pinggir pantai, menyaksikan ombak yang perlahan menghempas pantai. Suara gemericik air dan keramaian burung laut mengisi telingaku, menciptakan harmoni alam yang memukau. Sungguh momen yang menyenangkan untuk menikmati keindahan alam pagi di Pantai Kenjeran. Lumayan buat spot foto, disitu saya mengambil salah satu foto yang sengaja saya jadikan wallpaper HP bahkan laptop saya
Keren banget...
review_translated_text:
That morning, fresh air filled the road to Kenjeran Beach. I walked slowly, feeling the cool breeze. Along the way, green trees greeted me with their leaves rustling softly. When I arrived at the edge of the beach, my eyes were treated to a stunning panorama: the sky was slightly cloudy with the morning sun starting to rise, reflecting light on the calm sea surface. I sat on the rocks on the edge of the beach, watching the waves slowly crashing against the shore. The sound of gurgling water and the hustle and bustle of seabirds filled my ears, creating a stunning natural harmony. What a delightful moment to enjoy the beauty of the morning nature at Kenjeran Beach. Not bad for a photo spot, there I took one of the photos that I deliberately made my cellphone wallpaper and even my laptop
So cool...

name: BeeDDjoo
review_text:
Bingung juga mau ulas pantai ini dari sisi mana.
Secara wilayah termasuk area pantai Kenjeran tetapi di luar kawasan wisata. Jadi pantai ini secara real bukanlah kawasan wisata, sehingga bebas masuk alias gratis.
Tumpukan batu-batu sepertinya  bertujuan mencegah atau mengurangi abrasi daratan oleh air laut. Kemudian sepanjang tumpukan batu dipasang pagar besi agar tidak terusik oleh orang tidak bertanggung jawab. Dan beberapa bagian pagar dibuka untuk masuk lokasi.
Mengapa menjadi kawasan wisata? Entahlah... Satu-satunya yang menarik menurut saya hanya suasana teduh di sepanjang pantai. Pohon yang ditanam untuk penghijauan sudah tinggi dan rimbun menghalangi sinar matahari. Hembusan angin lumayan kencang menambah kesan sejuk.
review_translated_text:
I'm also confused about how to review this beach.
It's geographically part of the Kenjeran beach area, but outside the tourist area. So, this beach isn't actually a tourist area, so entry is free.
The piles of rocks appear to be intended to prevent or mitigate land erosion by seawater. Furthermore, an iron fence has been installed along the piles to prevent irresponsible people from disturbing it. Some sections of the fence are open to allow entry.
Why is it a tourist area? I don't know... The only thing that appeals to me is the shady atmosphere along the beach. The tall, lush trees that have been planted for reforestation block out the sun. A fairly strong breeze adds to the cool atmosphere.

name: Abiyyu Raihan Putra Wikanto
review_text:
Wisata Pesisir Laut yang dekat dengan Suramadu 

Atraksi dari tempat ini adalah struktur yang mirip dermaga di atas air yang menghadap jembatan suramadu serta gedung kapal yang tinggi. Lumayan untuk berehat dan menikmati suasana pesisir yang jarang ditemui di perkotaan. Anda bisa berfoto dengan properti foto menghadap Jembatan Suramadu atau bisa juga di atas gedung kapal yang tinggi.

Disini disediakan makanan dan minuman (karena memang aslinya adalah rumah makan). Harga untuk nugget adalah 13K dan Es Mango Yakult adalah 17K. Rasa Esnya sedikit kemanisan. Tersedia mushola bagi yang ingin shalat. Bagi pengguna motor dikenakan tarif parkir 5000 dan ada juru parkirnya.

Sayangnya jalan mulai dari gerbang kampung menuju ke tempat ini sangat rusak. Saya juga menyarankan bagi anda yang ingin untuk balik ke Surabaya menggunakan jalan di kiri SETELAH jembatan overpass dekat pesisir.

Jika anda menggunakan yang jalan yang menuju arah tanean maka anda harus menyebrang dari jalur pelan ke jalur cepat lalu berputar dimana kecepatannya bisa melebihi 80+ km/j!!. NB : Tips ini untuk motor, untuk mobil saya kurang tahu.
review_translated_text:
Coastal Tourism near Suramadu 

The attraction of this place is a structure that resembles a pier on the water facing the Suramadu Bridge and a tall ship building. It's quite good for taking a break and enjoying the coastal atmosphere that is rarely found in urban areas. You can take pictures with photo props facing the Suramadu Bridge or on top of the tall ship building.

Food and drinks are provided here (because it is actually a restaurant). The price for nuggets is 13K and Mango Yakult Ice is 17K. The taste of the ice is a little sweet. There is a prayer room for those who want to pray. Motorbike users are charged a parking fee of 5000 and there are parking attendants.

Unfortunately, the road from the village gate to this place is very damaged. I also suggest for those of you who want to return to Surabaya to use the road on the left AFTER the overpass bridge near the coast.

If you use the road that goes towards Tanean then you have to cross from the slow lane to the fast lane then turn around where the speed can exceed 80+ km/h!!. NB: This tip is for motorbikes, I don't know about cars.

name: Lukman Hakim Afifurrahman
review_text:
Datanglah ke sini diniatkan untuk menikmati senja dengan pemandangan laut tenang yang dilatarbelakangi oleh Jembatan Nasional Suramadu, cukup memesan minuman saja dan atau snack serta membayar parkir mobil 10rb parkir motor 5rb, anda bisa mengisi perut sebelum datang ke sini agar tidak merasa merugi.

Harga menu sebenarnya tidak terlalu mahal, juga tidak bisa dibilang murah, 10-20rb untuk minuman & snack, jauh lebih murah dari tempat sebelah (Kafe Pantai Rindu, yg mengharuskan 1 orang 1 menu seharga 25rb-an jika tidak pesan harus beli tiket masuk 10rb). Di sini tidak semahal itu, dan tidak ada tiket masuk jika tidak memesan menu, tetapi yang menjadi sorotan adalah kualitas produk yang disajikan sangat tidak sesuai dengan harganya dan banyak menu tidak tersedia.

Lokasi terlihat seperti kurang perawatan, kebersihannya juga kurang, tetapi secara struktural masih sangat kuat dan bisa dinikmati bersama keluarga dengan pengawasan terhadap anak-anak karena ada beberapa bagian yang kurang safety.

Sebagai penutup, kembali ke paragraf pertama, maka itulah yang kita cari dari tempat ini
review_translated_text:
Come here to enjoy the sunset with a serene ocean view with the Suramadu National Bridge as a backdrop. Simply order a drink and/or snack and pay 10,000 IDR for car parking and 5,000 IDR for motorcycles. You can fill up before coming here so you don't feel like you've missed out.

The menu prices aren't too expensive, but they're not cheap either: 10,000-20,000 IDR for drinks and snacks, much cheaper than the place next door (Kafe Pantai Rindu, which charges 25,000 IDR for one person and requires a 10,000 IDR entrance fee). It's not that expensive, and there's no entrance fee if you don't order a menu. However, the main concern is the quality of the food served, which is very underwhelming, and many menu items are unavailable.

The location appears to be under-maintained and lacking in cleanliness, but it's still structurally sound and can be enjoyed with the family with supervision, as some areas lack safety features.

In closing, going back to the first paragraph, that's what we're looking for in this place

review_text:
Saya baru-baru ini mengunjungi sebuah kawasan mangrove yang menakjubkan dan ingin berbagi pengalaman saya dengan Anda. Kawasan mangrove ini tidak hanya menawarkan pemandangan alam yang indah, tetapi juga dilengkapi dengan fasilitas yang memudahkan pengunjung seperti penjual makanan yang lezat dan gazebo yang nyaman untuk beristirahat. Selain itu, jalan setapak kayu yang tersedia membuat penjelajahan lebih menyenangkan.

Saat tiba di kawasan mangrove, saya langsung terpesona oleh keindahan alamnya. Pohon-pohon bakau yang menjulang tinggi dan akar-akar yang menjalar di atas air menciptakan pemandangan yang luar biasa. Udara segar dan harum menyapa saya saat berjalan melewati jalur setapak yang terbuat dari kayu.

Salah satu hal yang saya sukai dari kawasan mangrove ini adalah adanya penjual makanan di sekitar area tersebut. Setelah menikmati pemandangan yang memukau, saya dapat menikmati makanan lezat yang disediakan oleh para penjual. Rasanya benar-benar nikmat dan sesuai dengan suasana alam yang tenang.

Selama perjalanan saya di kawasan mangrove, saya juga menemukan beberapa gazebo yang tersebar di sekitar area tersebut. Gazebo-gazebo ini memberikan tempat yang sempurna untuk beristirahat dan menikmati pemandangan yang indah. Saya dapat duduk santai di dalam gazebo, menikmati sejuknya angin laut, sambil mendengarkan suara alam yang menenangkan.

Selain itu, jalan setapak kayu di kawasan mangrove ini merupakan tambahan yang luar biasa. Jalan setapak tersebut terawat dengan baik dan memberikan akses yang mudah bagi para pengunjung untuk menjelajahi kawasan mangrove. Saya merasa aman dan nyaman saat berjalan di atas jalan setapak kayu ini, yang memberikan pengalaman yang unik dan menyenangkan.

Secara keseluruhan, kawasan mangrove ini adalah tempat yang menakjubkan untuk dikunjungi. Kombinasi antara keindahan alam mangrove yang menawan, adanya penjual makanan yang lezat, gazebo yang nyaman, dan jalan setapak kayu yang memudahkan menjadikan pengalaman saya sangat memuaskan. Saya sangat merekomendasikan tempat ini kepada siapa pun yang ingin menikmati alam sekaligus menikmati hidangan lezat.

I recently visited a stunning mangrove area and wanted to share my experience with you. This mangrove area not only offers beautiful natural scenery, but is also equipped with facilities to make it easier for visitors, such as delicious food vendors and comfortable gazebos for resting. Furthermore, the wooden walkways make exploring even more enjoyable.

Upon arriving at the mangrove area, I was immediately captivated by its natural beauty. The towering mangrove trees and their roots stretching over the water created a stunning view. Fresh, fragrant air greeted me as I walked along the wooden walkways.

One of my favorite things about this mangrove area is the abundance of food vendors around the area. After enjoying the stunning scenery, I was able to enjoy the delicious food provided by the vendors. The taste was truly delicious and matched the tranquil natural atmosphere.

During my journey through the mangrove area, I also came across several gazebos scattered around the area. These gazebos provided the perfect place to rest and enjoy the beautiful scenery. I could relax inside the gazebo, enjoy the cool sea breeze, and listen to the soothing sounds of nature.

Furthermore, the wooden walkways in the mangrove area are a wonderful addition. They are well-maintained and provide easy access for visitors to explore the mangrove area. I felt safe and comfortable walking on these wooden walkways, which made for a unique and enjoyable experience.

Overall, this mangrove area is a wonderful place to visit. The combination of the captivating natural beauty of the mangroves, the delicious food vendors, the comfortable gazebos, and the easy wooden walkways made for a truly satisfying experience. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking to enjoy nature while enjoying delicious food.

From Surabaya, if you get off the Suramadu bridge, try to take the leftmost route, so you don't miss it.

review_text: Salah satu tempat wisata yang ada di kota gresik. Tepatnya di desa tanjung widoro, mengare. Untuk bisa masuk ke tempat wisata ini, pengunjung akan dikenakan biaya sebesar Rp 35.000 (dengan rincian Rp 20.000 tiket masuk wisata dan Rp 15.000 ongkos perahu pulang pergi). Di pulau ayang-ayang sendiri terdapat hutan bakau dengan berbagai spesies, pantai, bekas peninggalan belanda, dll. Di tempat ini pengunjung bisa berenang, bermain kayak (sejenis perahu dayung) tanpa perlu membayar lagi, bersantai, menyusuri hutan bakau, dll.
review_translated_text: One of the tourist attractions in the city of Gresik. Specifically, in the village of Tanjung Widoro, Mengare. The location is quite far from the center of Gresik and can be reached by motorbike or car. To enter this tourist attraction, visitors will be charged a fee of Rp 35,000 (with a breakdown of Rp 20,000 for the entrance ticket and Rp 15,000 for the round-trip boat fare). Ayang-Ayang Island itself is a sedimentary island. To reach it, you must use a boat to cross. On Ayang-Ayang Island itself, there are mangrove forests with various species, beaches, remnants of Dutch heritage, etc. Here, visitors can swim, play kayaks (a type of rowing boat) without having to pay again, relax, explore the mangrove forest, etc.

Pantai dominan berlumpur
di dominasi rumah nelayan pesisir dengan banyak kapal nelayan
terdapat area seperti kopi2 di pinggiran pantai
dan jajanan rakyat sperti cilok bakso tahu sate kerang dan lontong kupang.
spot area bisa melihat pulau madura dan jembatan suramadu dan hutan bakau.

review_translated_text:
This beach has no sand, only rocks.
The beach is predominantly muddy.
It is dominated by coastal fishermen's houses with numerous fishing boats.
There are areas like coffee shops along the shoreline.
And local snacks like cilok (meatballs, tofu), shellfish satay, and lontong kupang (rice cake).
The spot offers views of Madura Island, the Suramadu Bridge, and the mangrove forest.
The road access is good and well-maintained.
Many people sell smoked fish and seafood crackers. Perhaps the beach could be further improved as a tourist spot.

name: Nena Zakiah
review_text:
Beda banget Kenjeran yang dulu dan sekarang. Dulu Kenjeran sangat kumuh, kotor, banyak dipake untuk mesum, haha. Sekarang penataannya bagus banget, dipagari, ga ada parkir liar, trus ditanami pohon cemara pula, jadi makin asri dan rindang.

Untuk kesini, cukup parkirkan kendaraan di area Taman Suroboyo. Aku biasanya masukin motor ke dalem biar parkirnya jadi gratis. Trus duduk-duduk deh di beton yang menghadap ke laut. Bagus juga buat yang mau hunting foto human interest disini, bagus juga kalo mau liat sunrise (matahari terbit), karena arahnya ke timur gitu. Kalo sore asyik, anginnya sepoi-sepoi dan sejuk. Bisa ngeliat orang berlayar dan bersenang-senang ama keluarganya.

Kalo laper dan haus, ada yang jualan pentol, lontong kupang dan es. Terjamin deh, lagian juga murah kok.
review_translated_text:
Kenjeran is so different now than it was then. It used to be very rundown, dirty, and often used for lewd activities, haha. Now it's beautifully landscaped: fenced, no illegal parking, and planted with pine trees, making it even more beautiful and shady.

To get here, simply park your vehicle in the Suroboyo Park area. I usually pull my motorcycle inside so parking is free. Then sit on the concrete facing the sea. It's also great for those looking for human interest photos, and especially if you want to watch the sunrise, as it faces east. In the afternoon, it's nice, with a gentle, cool breeze. You can watch people sailing and having fun with their families.

If you're hungry or thirsty, there are stalls selling meatballs (pentol), rice cakes (lontong kupang), and ice. It's guaranteed, and it's also cheap.

There are several tunnels that are connected to each other. You can enter the tunnel. Some interesting spots for taking pictures. It needs better management and maintenance, because the local tourism assets also contribute to driving the economy of the surrounding community. Access roads should be improved for driving safety for tourists who go there.

review_text:
Bukit Jaddih sejatinya adalah tambang kapur. Uniknya, saat ini pertambangan masih berlangsung, sehingga ada alat berat dan truk yang berlalu-lalang mengangkut batu kapur.
Menuju Bukit Jaddih tidak terlalu susah. Dari Surabaya setelah melewati Jembatan Suramadu, langsung saja gunakan aplikasi pencari arah. Meski letaknya gampang dicari, tapi tetap harus waspada karena jalan ke Bukit Jaddih terhitung sempit dan beberapa titik berlubang.
Hanya butuh sekitar 20 menit dari Jembatan Suramadu ke Bukit Jaddih. Cukup membayar Rp 20.000 untuk parkir mobil dan Rp 5.000 per orang untuk masuk ke lokasi.
Dikelilingi tembok-tembok bukit kapur yang terpahat cerahnya langit adalah kombinasi serasi. Jangan takut, kedalaman air di danau itu rata-rata 70 sentimeter (cm).
review_translated_text:
Jaddih Hill is actually a limestone quarry. Interestingly, the mining is still ongoing, so heavy equipment and trucks are frequently seen transporting limestone.
Getting to Jaddih Hill isn't difficult. From Surabaya, after crossing the Suramadu Bridge, simply use a navigation app. While it's easy to find, be cautious, as the road to Jaddih Hill is narrow and has several potholes.
It only takes about 20 minutes from the Suramadu Bridge to Jaddih Hill. You only need to pay Rp 20,000 for parking and Rp 5,000 per person to enter.
Surrounded by limestone hills, the clear sky is a harmonious combination. Don't worry, the lake's water depth is an average of 70 centimeters (cm).

review_text:
Ini adalah ulasan terakhir saya setelah 5kali berkunjung dalam beberapa Periode. Mulai dari Awal2 viral di 2015 hingga akhir Era Corona.

Jika anda melihat dan membaca ulasan saya, jika anda mengharapkan Jeddih adalah tempat yang indah ? Dan ingin segera mengunjunginya ? Maka segera urungkan niat itu dan coba cari Destinasi wisata yang lain.

Jeddih hari ini tidaklah seindah Jeddih diawal2 viral dulu ditahun 2015.

Hari ini jeddih begitu hancur tidak terawat serta banyak sekali pungli.

Jeddih sangat berbeda dengan yang saya kenal dulu masih Batuan kapur yang indah dengan Area perbukitannya yang masih banyak ditumbuhi rumput dan pepohonan hijau.

Kini semua tempat itu telah lenyap. Tidak tersisa sedikitpun hal indah ditempat ini. Yang ada hanyalah Kehancuran dan pungli.

Semoga Madura menawarkan destinasi wisata yang memorable lagi.
review_translated_text:
This is my last review after 5 visits in several periods. Starting from the beginning of viral in 2015 until the end of the Corona Era. 

If you see and read my review, if you expect Jeddih to be a beautiful place? And want to visit it soon? Then immediately cancel that intention and try to find another tourist destination. 

Jeddih today is not as beautiful as Jeddih at the beginning of viral in 2015. 

Today Jeddih is so destroyed, unkempt and there are lots of extortion. 

Jeddih is very different from what I used to know, it was still beautiful limestone with a hilly area that was still overgrown with grass and green trees. 

Now all those places have disappeared. There is not a single beautiful thing left in this place. All there is is destruction and extortion. 

Hopefully Madura will offer a memorable tourist destination again.

review_text:
Kesini karena nonton konten kreator TT,  ada dua rute yang bisa kearah sana dan saya pilih rute dalam.
Medan jalan ketika sampai disana benar-benar susah dan sepertinya cocok jika pakai mobil 4x4, dan karena di bukit kapur jadi hawanya lebih panas dan terik banget.

+ Ada warung dekat pondok pesantren, jadi ketika haus atau lapar bisa kesana dan penjualnya ramah. Sebisa mungkin bawa perbekalan yang cukup.
+ Kesana waktu jam kerja dan sepi bangett, jadi leluasa mencari spot foto. Namun tetap hati-hati karena tidak ada pagar penghalang dan bisa jatuh kebawah jika ceroboh.

- Kalau berkunjung kesana waktu musim kemarau siap-siap topi dan kacamata karena panas banget dan terik.
review_translated_text:
I came here because I watched TT's content. There are two routes to get there, and I chose the inner route.
The road is really difficult to get to and seems best suited for a 4x4. Because it's on a limestone hill, the weather is hotter and more intense.

+ There's a food stall near the Islamic boarding school, so if you're thirsty or hungry, you can go there, and the vendors are friendly. Bring enough supplies if possible.
+ I went there during working hours and it was very quiet, so I had plenty of space to find a photo spot. However, be careful, as there are no guardrails and you could fall if you're careless.

- If you visit during the dry season, be prepared with a hat and sunglasses, as it's very hot and sweltering.

review_text:
Pantai Batu Putih adalah pantai yang berada di Dsn. Batu Putih Ds.Sreseh Kec.Sreseh Kab.Sampang,tepatnya di sebelah selatan laut madura-jawa atau tepatnya di utara PULAU MANDANGIN di madura.
Pantai Batu Putih bukan hanya pantai yang cantik, indah di pandang oleh mata, tetapi juga pantai tempat sumber rezeki bagi warga setempat...
Kenapa di bilang tempat sumber rezeki...????
Karena pantai ini mempunyai banyak macam bintang yang boleh di makan contohnya,ikan,udang,kerang(macam2 jenis kerang),kepiting,rajungan, lorjuk (bahasa madura),tiram, se'e(bahasa madura) dan banyak lagi jenis siput yang bisa di makan.
Intinya pantai batu putih adalah tempat mata pencaharian orang batu putih mencari binatang -binatang di laut yang bisa di makan.
Dan juga tempat untuk berfoto-foto (kalau mau ambil gambar di sarankan datang sore).
Pantai Batu Putih memang terbaik
review_translated_text:
Batu Putih Beach is located in Batu Putih Hamlet, Sreseh Village, Sreseh District, Sampang Regency, to the south of the Madura-Java Sea, or more precisely, north of Mandangin Island in Madura.
Batu Putih Beach is not only a beautiful beach, a sight to behold, but also a source of livelihood for the locals...
Why is it called a source of livelihood...????
Because this beach has many types of edible seafood, such as fish, shrimp, clams (various types of shellfish), crabs, swimming crabs, lorjuk (Madurese), oysters, se'e (Madurese), and many other types of edible snails.
Essentially, Batu Putih Beach is where the Batu Putih people make their living by finding edible marine life.
It's also a great place for taking photos (if you want to take pictures, it's recommended to come in the afternoon).
Batu Putih Beach is truly the best.

name: Ronny Hidayat
review_text:
Pantai Batu Putih
*
Pantai kecil di kawasan perkampungan nelayan yang terletak di Kec. Sreseh Kab. Sampang, posisi Sreseh ini cukup rumit ya, sebab lokasinya dengan Sampang kota terpotong oleh sungai, dan jika kita ingin menuju kota, harus memutar melewati Blega, karena tidak adanya jembatan yang dibangun untuk menghubungkan belahan sungai.
Seperti pantai di perkampungan nelayan pada umumnya, selalu ada sampah rumah tangga yang bertebaran. Dengan bibir pantai yang pendek, mungkin cuma 300 meteran (hitungan ngawur) suasana yang ditawarkan cukup bisa dinikmati, khususnya jika anda berada di sisi timur pantai, dimana kondisi pasir lebih bersih dari sampah dan tidak ada pohon bakau kecil yang menghalangi anda untuk bermain air atau sekedar bersantai sambil memandangi lautan yang akan terlihat pulau Mandangin di kejauhan, pulau kecil yang terlihat cukup padat jika dilihat dari citra satelit.
Sepertinya nyebrang kesana boleh juga. 
Di sisi barat pantai ada bengkel perbaikan perahu tradisional, proses pengecatan masih sangat2 tradisional, mempergunakan benang sebagai garis bantu. 
Bisa dibilang menemukan pantai ini adalah sebuah kebetulan, tadinya saya kira cuma pantai belakang rumah nelayan yang hanya sekian petak, ternyata lumayan. Sebab tidak ada petunjuk apa2, hanya berdasar rasa penasaran setelah melihat bengkel perahu, akhirnya saya beranikan diri untuk masuk ke jalan setapak rumah orang yang kebetulan terlihat bibir pantainya dari tepi jalan, dan hasilnya... tadaaa...
Jangan lupa bahagia.....

review_translated_text:
White Rock Beach
*
Small beach in the fishing village area located in Kec. Sreseh District. Sampang, the position of Sreseh is quite complicated, because its location with Sampang, the city is cut off by a river, and if we want to go to the city, we have to detour via Blega, because there is no bridge built to connect the river.
Like beaches in fishing villages in general, there is always household rubbish scattered around. With a short shoreline, perhaps only 300 meters (inconsequential calculations), the atmosphere offered is quite enjoyable, especially if you are on the east side of the beach, where the sand is cleaner from rubbish and there are no small mangrove trees to prevent you from playing in the water or just relaxing while looking at the ocean and you will see Mandangin Island in the distance, a small island that looks quite dense when viewed from satellite images.
Looks like you can cross there too. 
On the west side of the beach there is a traditional boat repair workshop, the painting process is still very traditional, using thread as a guide line. 
You could say that finding this beach was a coincidence, at first I thought it was just a beach behind fishermen's houses, but it turns out it's not bad. Because there weren't any clues, just based on curiosity after seeing a boat repair shop, I finally had the courage to enter the footpath of someone's house where the shoreline happened to be visible from the edge of the road, and the result... tadaaa...
Don't forget to be happy.....

review_translated_text:
Jumiang Beach in Pamekasan is truly a hidden paradise! The first time I visited, I immediately fell in love with its calm and serene atmosphere. The sand is pristine white and the water is crystal clear, making it a perfect place to linger, splashing in the water or simply relaxing, enjoying the view.
What makes this beach even more special is that the waves aren't too big, making it perfectly safe for families with children. Plus, there are plenty of Instagrammable photo spots to enhance your Instagram feed.

review_text:
Disini ada 2 tempat tujuan. Pantai jumiang dan pantai jumiang indah.
Pantai jumiang pemandangan batu2 karang dan pengunjung tidak bisa main pasir atau air. Dan untuk akses tangga kayunya banyak yg rusak dan lapuk seperti tidak terawat.

Tiket masuknya murah meriah, penjual makanan juga banyak.

Dari keduanya yg sangat disayangkan adalah banyak sampah berserakan. Apakah karena kurangnya tempat sampah yg disediakan atau memang kurangnya kesadaran pengunjung. Sangat sayang sekali, padahal pantainya cantik tp jadi berkurang cantiknya krn banyaknya sampah :( semoga hal ini menjadi perhatian pihak terkait.
Next pengen kesini lagi tapi di sore hari lihat sunset :)
review_translated_text:
There are 2 destinations here. Jumiang Beach and Jumiang Indah Beach.
Jumiang Beach has a view of coral rocks and visitors cannot play in the sand or water. And for access to the wooden stairs, many are damaged and rotten as if not maintained.
While Jumiang Indah Beach can swim and play in the sand.
The entrance ticket is cheap, there are also many food sellers.

Of the two, what is very unfortunate is the large amount of garbage scattered around. Is it because of the lack of trash bins provided or the lack of awareness of visitors. It's a shame, even though the beach is beautiful, it becomes less beautiful because of the large amount of garbage :( hopefully this will be a concern for the relevant parties.
Next, I want to come here again but in the afternoon to see the sunset :)

The beach is quite nice, the waves are calm, so it's safe for swimming nearby, and there are plenty of shaded spots.

Unfortunately, the prices for snacks, drinks, and food are quite expensive, perhaps considering the distance from the main island to the main transportation network, so it's understandable.

review_text:
Wisata pantai yang relatif masih alami yang berada di Pulau Giligenting di gugusan pulau-pulau di selat Madura di selatan Sumenep, tepatnya di Desa Bringsang.

Pantainya bersih dan tenang dengan pasir putih dan desiran angin dan ombak yang membuat rileks. Banyak pondok dan gazebo maupun kursi santai yang tersedia di sepanjang pantai. Tersedia juga vila/bungalow resor yang dapat digunakan untuk menginap. Air di kamar mandinya menyegarkan dan tidak payau. Tersedia juga banyak warung yang menyediakan makanan maupun kebutuhan sehari-hari. Musola dan masjid juga tidak jauh dari pantai ini. Tersedia juga wahana permainan banana boat dan speed boat.

Untuk menuju ke pantai ini harus menyeberang dari Pelabuhan Tanjung Saronggi di Pulau Madura dengan menggunakan perahu kayu. Sepeda motor bisa diangkut masuk ke perahu kayu dengan ongkos yg terjangkau. perjalanan menyeberangi Selat Madura dari Tanjung ke pelabuhan Bringsang di Giligenting memerlukan waktu sekitar 20-30 menit. Ombak laut cukup tinggi di jam-jam tertentu, sehingga disarankan pintar-pintar untuk memilih waktu penyeberangan. sepertinya waktu ombak cukup tenang adalah pada siang hari antara jam 10 sampai 12 siang.

Pantai ini tidak jauh dari pelabuhan Bringsang, bisa langsung dijangkau dengan berjalan kaki sekitar 5 menit ke arah timur begitu perahu merapat ke dermaga.
review_translated_text:
A relatively pristine beach resort located on Giligenting Island, in the Madura Strait archipelago south of Sumenep, specifically in Bringsang Village.

The beach is clean and calm, with white sand and relaxing breezes and waves. Numerous huts, gazebos, and lounge chairs are available along the shore. There are also resort villas/bungalows available for overnight stays. The bathroom water is refreshing and not brackish. Numerous food stalls and stalls offer food and daily necessities. A prayer room (musholla) and a mosque are also nearby. Banana boat and speedboat rides are also available.

To reach this beach, you must cross from Tanjung Saronggi Harbor on Madura Island by wooden boat. Motorcycles can be loaded onto the wooden boat for an affordable fee. The trip across the Madura Strait from Tanjung Saronggi Harbor to Bringsang Harbor in Giligenting takes about 20-30 minutes. The waves can be quite high at certain times of the day, so it's recommended to choose your crossing time wisely. The calmest times are between 10 and 12 noon.

This beach is not far from Bringsang harbor, it can be reached directly by walking about 5 minutes to the east once the boat docks at the pier.

review_translated_text:
A pristine beach...
The sea with gentle waves is safe from coral and still very beautiful to the eye.
The sand is fine... safe for children to play in the sand and waves.

The pine trees are still well-preserved, although some have been lost.

There's a horse riding destination...
And the rujak cingur (rice cake) vendor is addictive.

Not to mention the typical Madurese coffee...
Maize coffee, haha.

Continue to improve to become a better tourism destination.
Hopefully, Lombang Beach will remain sustainable.

review_translated_text:
The first time I visited Sumenep, I immediately fell in love with Lombang Beach. Despite the abundance of horses, it's relatively clean, free of horse manure.

The beach environment is also clean. When we arrived after midday prayers, there weren't many visitors. As evening approached, many young people arrived, and it was indeed a great place to enjoy the sunset, accompanied by a gentle breeze.

Unfortunately, the restrooms/bathrooms are poorly maintained; the taps don't turn on. It's very difficult to relieve yourself. I urge the management to pay more attention to the facilities and amenities for the comfort of tourists.

review_translated_text: Slopeng Beach in Sumenep is a captivating marine tourism destination with expansive white sand and a long coastline. The clear blue sea is perfect for splashing in the water or enjoying the scenery. Its main attraction is the unique sand dunes, making it a charming natural photo spot. Visitors can also try exciting experiences like horseback riding or exploring the beach on an ATV. The cool atmosphere, with soothing sea breezes, is perfect for family outings or relaxing vacations. One of the beaches in Sumenep for a vacation with family and loved ones. The parking lot is quite spacious, and there are many vendors selling coconut milk, rujak (traditional coconut fruit salad), and other food. It's best to come here in the afternoon to watch the sunset.

Perfect for a family vacation, I always go here on weekdays because it's not always crowded, so it feels like a private beach.  The meatballs are delicious, I've never found them anywhere else, so I always make time to buy them. You can ride and ride ATVs around the beach.

It's relatively clean from the parking lot to the shoreline... But the beach itself is very dirty. There are plenty of trash cans, but many visitors still litter. There's a prayer room and adequate restrooms, and ample parking.

Don't forget to try the Madurese fruit rujak and other culinary delights.

review_translated_text:
E KASOGHI BEACH
Truly offers stunning natural beauty, a place we can visit with family, alone, or with others.
The charm of walking amidst the mangroves and the bamboo bridges makes us feel like we've traveled back in time, to a time of beauty and tranquility, free from pollution.

E Kasoghi Beach is located in Saronggi, Sumenep Regency. If coming from Surabaya, it's just before entering the city or after passing through BLUTO District.

It's perfect for those heading to Sumenep city or from Sumenep heading towards Surabaya. You can stop by at the Saronggi intersection.

It's very safe and comfortable. Although you have to walk a short distance to the parking lot, the beauty is well worth it.

The entrance fee is 10,000 Rupiah per person, and parking is very affordable: 3,000 Rupiah for motorbikes and 5,000 Rupiah for cars.

We plan to visit E Kasoghi Beach soon, as once you've been there, you'll be hooked by its calming atmosphere. Greetings

review_translated_text:
A unique beach recreation spot. To reach it, you have to walk from the motorcycle/car parking area for about 10-15 minutes, along a path that crosses rice paddy fields and swamps.
This beach is open from morning to night.
There's a bamboo bridge and gazebo over the mangroves, which is interesting.
The beach is safe, as seen by the number of children and adults still swimming along the shore even though it's already quite late.
There's a cafeteria serving food and light drinks.
Visitors can also rent tents if they want to spend the night on this beach.
There are plenty of restrooms.
If you're returning late at night, be a little careful, as the path is only lit by lamps spaced quite far apart. But for me, that's quite an adrenaline rush.
Nice place...

review_translated_text:
In Madura, especially Sumenep, there are many beautiful beaches. One of them is this beach ..e Kashogi.
About 17 km from the center of Sumenep.
To reach it via a fairly small road. The parking lot for cars and motorbikes is very spacious .. although it is simple ..
Then you have to walk along a footpath about 200 meters.
The later it gets the more beautiful ..
If you come quite late in the evening, you have to be careful for the minimal lighting along the way to the beach .. a bit scary because it is dimly lit by lights that are quite far away. But it can be an unparalleled experience .. ticket 10 thousand. Open until 21.00
There are tents provided  for those interested in staying overnight ..
Public toilets are sufficient. Although a little not maintained cleanliness ..
There is a bamboo bridge around the beach ... And several bamboo gazebos above the mangrove beach.

review_text:
alam sudah memberikan anugerah lokasi yang hebat, karena pantai keris ini seperti membelah laut madura menjadi dua dengan pantai. cuma orang-orang di sumenep terutama Pemda adalah orang-orang yang tidak bisa mensyukuri nikmat Tuhan lewat pemberian pantai keris.

saya sengaja datang ke pantai keris untuk, tadinya melihat keindahan alam ini, cuma:

1. akses menuju pantai keris lebih buruk dari kita melakukan KKN semasa kuliah, jalanan buruk dan boleh dibilang ngga ada akses yang manusiawi (ini jelas PR Pemda)

2. satu-satunya jembatan menuju lokasi terbuat dari bambu dan itu buat beberapa orang yang takut ngga akan berani mencoba (ini jelas PR Pemda Sumenep lagi)

3. yang paling parah adalah SAMPAH di pantai itu luar biasa banyaknya, mungkin banyak orang TOLOL yang datang mau sekedar foto terus meniggalkan sisa makanan dan minuman seenaknya ajah,. buat yang pernah buang sampah di pantai keris: EH! TOLOL ELU BEGO BANGET YAH, KENAPA NGGA ELU BAWA DULU SAMPAH ELU DAN BUANG DI RUMAH ELU AJAH SAMPAH!!!!!!

4. ngga ada petunjuk yang jelas untuk menuju pantai keris ini, yang google berikan bahkan musti lewat rumah penduduk dan itu salah jadi musti lewat gudang garam.

jadi bintang 2 untuk lokasi ini bukan say berikan untuk anugerah pantai yang sudah Tuhan berikan, tapi untuk PEMDA dan orang-orang tolol yang pernah ke pantai keris dan meninggalkan sampah seenak jidatnya ajah. Bego luh!!!!
review_translated_text:
Nature has blessed us with a magnificent location, as Keris Beach seems to divide the Madura Sea into two, along with the beach. However, the people of Sumenep, especially the local government, are unable to appreciate God's blessings through the gift of Keris Beach.

I came to Keris Beach on purpose, initially to see this natural beauty, but:

1. Access to Keris Beach is worse than when we did our Community Service Program during college. The roads are bad and there's practically no humane access (this is clearly the local government's responsibility).

2. The only bridge to the location is made of bamboo, and that's why some people who are afraid won't dare try (this is clearly the Sumenep local government's responsibility again).

3. The worst part is the incredible amount of TRASH on the beach. There are probably a lot of idiots who come just to take photos and leave their food and drink leftovers. For those of you who have ever thrown trash at Keris Beach: OH! YOU'RE SO STUPID, WHY DON'T YOU TAKE YOUR TRASH WITH YOU AND THROW IT AWAY AT HOME!!!!!!

4. There are no clear directions to Keris Beach. The ones Google gives you have to go through a local's house, which is wrong, so you have to go through Gudang Garam.

So, I'm not giving this location 2 stars for the beach that God has given, but for the local government and the idiots who have been to Keris Beach and left trash everywhere. You're so stupid!!!!

Jika kesana paling enak pagi atau sore karena jalan menuju pantai kita harus jalan kaki melewati tambak sekitar 500 meter. Jika pantai ini dikelola serius oleh warga setempat atau pemda maka pantai ini pasti akan ikonik karena indahnya pemandangan dan uniknya pantai ini yang membentang seperti keris dengan pemandangan pelabuhan Kalianget serta ombak yang tenang.

The best time to visit is in the morning or afternoon, as the beach requires a 500-meter walk through fish ponds. If this beach is seriously managed by local residents or the local government, it will surely become an icon for its beautiful scenery and unique features, stretching like a keris (a dagger) with views of Kalianget Harbor and calm waves.

Untuk ke pulau ini membutuhkan extra effort.
Kita harus menyebrang dulu ke pulau giliraja dengan menggunakan kapal angkutan yg biasa ada di dermaga bluto.
Sesampainya di pulau giliraja, kita harus menuju ke dermaga banmaleng untuk bisa menyebrang ke pulau bidadari.
Di banmaleng pun, hanya akan ada 1 atau 2 kapal penduduk lokal yg akan menyebrang.
Jadi kita harus bertanya pada penduduk lokal ada atau enggaknya angkutan ke pulau bidadari.
Selamat bertualang...
review_translated_text:
To get to this island requires extra effort. 
We must first cross to Giliraja Island using a transport ship that is usually available at Bluto Pier. 
Once we arrive at Giliraja Island, we must go to Banmaleng Pier to be able to cross to Bidadari Island. 
In Banmaleng, there will only be 1 or 2 local boats that will cross. 
So we have to ask the locals whether there is transportation to Bidadari Island or not. 
Happy adventure...

name: Ivan Prayoga
review_text: Pantai Kahuripan di Gili Genting, Madura, adalah surga tersembunyi dengan pesona pasir putih yang lembut dan air laut biru jernih. Suasananya tenang, alami, dan jauh dari hiruk pikuk, sehingga sangat cocok untuk melepas penat. Pemandangan sunrise maupun sunset di pantai ini benar-benar indah dan instagramable. Warga sekitar ramah, harga tiket maupun kuliner yang ditawarkan cukup ramah di kantong. Tempat ini sangat direkomendasikan bagi wisatawan yang mencari ketenangan, keindahan, sekaligus pengalaman liburan yang berkesan.
review_translated_text: Kahuripan Beach on Gili Genting, Madura, is a hidden paradise, captivated by soft white sand and crystal-clear blue waters. The atmosphere is serene, natural, and far from the hustle and bustle, making it the perfect place to unwind. The sunrise and sunset views from this beach are truly beautiful and Instagrammable. The locals are friendly, and the prices for tickets and culinary delights are affordable. This spot is highly recommended for travelers seeking tranquility, beauty, and a memorable vacation experience.

Pantai bertebing, dengan pemandangan laut yg menakjubkan. Ada beberapa tempat duduk atau gazebo. Kalau untuk anak-anak, mungkin kurang asyik, karena hanya menikmati pemandangan.
review_translated_text: One of the beaches in the Sumenep archipelago, Madura. The beach is at the end of the island. From the port on the island (Gili Genting), the distance to this place is quite a distance, about 14 km, and that too via a road that is uninhabited at the end. The beach has cliffs, with stunning sea views. There are several seats or gazebos. For children, it might be less fun, because they only enjoy the scenery.

review_text:
Lokasi pantai ini ada di ujung selatan pulau gili genting. Sekitar 8 km dari pantai sembilan di sebelah utara pulau.

Tempatnya cukup sepi dan tenang, belum banyak wisatawan. Tidak ada loket tiket maupun juru parkir, kita bisa bebas explore disini.

Akses kesini hanya ada satu jalan. Jika ditempuh menggunakan motor, waktu yang diubutuhkan sekitar 20-30 menit dari pantai sembilan.

Jangan sampai kehabisan bensin dijalan karena lokasi pantai cukup jauh dari kampung, ada penjual bensin eceran di desa terakhir sebelum sampai di pantai ini. Tapi sebaiknya sebelum menyeberang ke gili genting kita isi bensin dulu di sumenep, biar lebih tenang explore gili genting.

Sepertinya cocok banget bagi yang suka camping, ada banyak spot untuk dijadikan camping ground.
review_translated_text:
This beach is located at the southern tip of Gili Genting Island, about 8 km from Sembilan Beach in the north of the island.

It's quite quiet and peaceful, with few tourists. There are no ticket counters or parking attendants, so you can explore freely.

There's only one road to get there. If you're traveling by motorbike, it takes about 20-30 minutes from Sembilan Beach.

Don't run out of gas on the way, as the beach is quite far from the village. There's a petrol vendor in the last village before you reach the beach. However, it's best to refuel in Sumenep before crossing to Gili Genting to have a more relaxed experience exploring Gili Genting.

It seems perfect for camping enthusiasts, as there are plenty of spots for camping.

review_text:
Pantai Ponjuk, mungkin masih terasa asing di teliga kita, lokasinya terletak di ujung timur Pulau Poteran atau Pulau Palango (entah yang benar yang mana, warga sekitar nyebutnya Talango, di maps namanya Puteran) Kecamatan Talango Kabupaten Sumenep.
Akses menuju kesini cukup mudah, dari pelabuhan Kalianget nyebrang ke Pulau Puteran pakai kapal entah apa itu namanya, karna jaraknya sangat dekat mungkin nyebrangnya nggak sampai 10 menit dan ongkosnya cuma Rp. 5000 (saya dengan motor saya), terus ke arah timur sekitar 16km dari pintu masuk pulau Puteran kalau lewat tengah, dan 18km kalau lewat pesisir utara pulau.
Sangat cocok bagi pemburu sunrise, karena langsung menghadap lautan arah timur, terlihat juga beberapa pulau dari pantai tsb sepertu pulau Sapudi, Gililabak dan beberapa pulau lainnya.
Kalau buat camping saya belum paham sih diperbolehkan atau tidak, soalnya disitu ada tempat yang disakralkan, tapi kalau buat wisata yang anti mainstream ini sangat cocok, boleh dimasukkan ke list wisata anti mainstream anda.
review_translated_text:
Ponjuk Beach, perhaps unfamiliar to many, is located on the eastern tip of Poteran Island or Palango Island (which is unclear, but locals call it Talango; on maps, it's called Puteran), in Talango District, Sumenep Regency.
Access is quite easy. From Kalianget Harbor, cross to Puteran Island by boat (whatever name it's called). The distance is very close, so the crossing takes less than 10 minutes and costs only Rp. 5,000 (I rode my motorcycle). Continue east, about 16 km from the Puteran Island entrance if you go through the middle, and 18 km if you go along the north coast.
It's perfect for sunrise hunters, as it directly faces the ocean to the east. Several islands, such as Sapudi, Gililabak, and several others, are also visible from the beach. I don't know if camping is allowed or not, because there is a sacred place there, but if you want to go on an anti-mainstream trip, this is very suitable, you can add it to your anti-mainstream trip list.
